description: Header file defining the Camera3FakeStream class, a placeholder output stream for camera hardware in Android, used when no valid streams are configured.

classes.name: Camera3FakeStream
classes.description: A fake output stream class used as a placeholder in Android camera HAL, providing default behaviors and fake parameters.

methods.name: Camera3FakeStream
methods.description: Constructor that sets up a fake stream with a given ID.

methods.name: ~Camera3FakeStream
methods.description: Destructor for the Camera3FakeStream class.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the state of the stream for debugging.

methods.name: setTransform
methods.description: Sets a transformation on the stream.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from the stream.

methods.name: dropBuffers
methods.description: Drops buffers for the stream if specified.

methods.name: getPhysicalCameraId
methods.description: Returns the physical camera ID associated with the stream.

methods.name: isVideoStream
methods.description: Checks if the stream is for video encoding.

methods.name: isConsumerConfigurationDeferred

methods.name: setConsumers
methods.description: Sets consumer surfaces for the stream.

methods.name: getSurfaceId
methods.description: Returns the surface ID for a given surface.

methods.name: getUniqueSurfaceIds
methods.description: Retrieves unique surface IDs.

methods.name: updateStream
methods.description: Updates the output surfaces of the stream.

methods.name: setBatchSize
